text:
samir: quick sanity check on PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 - refactors provider usage into shared 'infra-providers' module, pins provider versions in root lockfile. planning canary deploy to staging tonight. any red flags?

infra-bot: CI: pipeline #482 passed (plan + fmt) :white_check_mark:

maya: looks fine at a glance. did you keep registry mirrors for gcp? provider block change can affect SA binding.

samir: yes, mirror config preserved. main concern: provider 4.3.x introduces diff for bigtable resource. we only touch networking modules though.

tom: if only networking modules, prefer pin to 3.8.x for now to be safe. we can opt into 4.x in a follow-up.

jordan: Heads up: k8s secret path names changed in k8s/helm module. quick snippet I tested locally:

```
resource "kubernetes_secret" "app-creds" {
  metadata {
    name = "app-creds"
    namespace = var.namespace
    labels = { managed_by = "terraform" }
  }

  data = { ".dockerconfigjson" = base64encode(var.dockerconfig) }
  type = "kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson"
}
```

samir: Thanks. I'll run a terraform plan against staging state and post plan output. If plan only touches metadata label and provider pins, I'll proceed with canary (single region).

maya: @samir ping me after plan, I'll grep for any bigtable/resource diffs.

tom: Also add a lockfile note in PR template: 'REGENERATE LOCKFILE if changing provider versions' — I've added a checklist item to our infra handbook.

samir: plan shows only lockfile and provider blocks, plus label on k8s secret. no resource replacements. running apply to staging at 21:00 UTC unless objections.

jordan: :thumbsup: no objections from my side.

maya: :+1: schedule looks good. canary with traffic routing via feature flag?

samir: yes, I'll do canary and watch latency/errs on console dashboards. will rollback if anything anomalous.

tom: thanks team. small nit: mention cloud creds rotation window in PR description next time.

infra-bot: deploy triggered for staging canary by samir at 1717123600 :gear:

samir: closing loop — applied successfully. will monitor for 30m then open Dedicated rollout ticket.
